//: Template for Raspberry Pi Imager's 'Use custom' -> local JSON feature, or a --repo URL. tools/make_rpi_image.sh fills in the extract_/image_download_ size and sha256 fields for whichever architecture it just built, from a copy of this file. It does NOT fill in 'url' (where you host the .img.xz - GitHub Releases or your own web space; this repo has no publishing pipeline for that yet) or 'icon' (an AutoBleem icon URL), and leaves 'devices' out on purpose - Imager treats a missing 'devices' as 'offer this OS everywhere', which is the safe default until the exact device-tag vocabulary Imager expects is confirmed against Raspberry Pi's own published os_list_imagingutility.json (not verified as part of this work - see payload_rpi/README.md's Raspberry Pi Imager section). Every field here starting with __ is a placeholder token; nothing with one should be used to flash a real card until it's replaced.
